Corollary
[vanishing under pointwise positive Ricci curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0352 ↗ thm:pet-ch9-bochner-vanishing-1forms 1. ch9:9.2.4Under the assumptions of subsection 2.2, if $\operatorname {Ric}$ is positive definite at some point, then $\mathcal H^1(M)=0$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch9-harmonic-1forms-vanish-positive-ricci \sketch By subsection 2.2, the dual field $X$ is parallel and $\operatorname {Ric}(X,X)=0$. Positive definiteness at one point forces $X$ to vanish there, hence everywhere.

□
